quirks.description: wp-site-blocks is the only direct body child, triggering SPA heuristic. FSE sites are fully server-rendered.
quirks.workaround: Use .wp-site-blocks > * as primarySelector. The site is not an SPA.

quirks.description: CSS stylesheets are loaded per-block per-page. Different pages have different stylesheets in <head>.
quirks.workaround: Extract styles per-page. Do not assume block CSS from one page exists on another.

quirks.description: Inline SVG filters injected after <body> for duotone image effects appear as spurious DOM elements.
quirks.workaround: Skip svg elements in section discovery.

quirks.description: wp-container-{random-id} classes change every page load. Cannot be used for CSS targeting.
quirks.workaround: Ignore wp-container-* classes. Use semantic is-layout-* and wp-block-* classes.

quirks.description: Group/Cover blocks wrap children in *__inner-container divs, adding extra nesting.
quirks.workaround: Collapse __inner-container wrappers into parent during style extraction.

quirks.description: Navigation block uses data-wp-interactive directives, not React. Hamburger menu is a modal overlay.
quirks.workaround: Extract static nav HTML. Rebuild responsive menu behavior in Next.js.

quirks.description: Nested has-global-padding elements can double horizontal padding.
quirks.workaround: Check parent chain for has-global-padding before applying padding values.

quirks.description: Responsive images use filename suffixes (-1024x768.jpg) not URL params.
quirks.workaround: Strip -\d+x\d+ suffix to find original. Parse srcset for largest version.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
